highlights.title: Fix basal rate editor rounding on 0.01 U/h pumps
changes: Basal rates no longer revert to 0.01 after reopening. Saving will correct profiles with the wrong lowest rate.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1674: Fix basal rate editor saving the lowest rate on 0.01 U/h pumps

includedPullRequests.title: Fix basal rate editor saving the lowest rate on 0.01 U/h pumps
includedPullRequests.body:
closes #1669

changes in:
- basal rate editor (`BasalProfileEditorProvider`, `BasalProfileEditor.StateModel`)
- pump setup from Home (`HomeStateModel`)
- pump settings (`PumpConfigStateModel`)
- Autotune basal sync (`AutotuneConfigStateModel`)

as @Frans6812 showed on a Dana-i, and @MikePlante1 saw on a Tandem Mobi, the rate shows as 0.01 after a reopen. it hits pumps whose rate list has a 0.01 U/h step; a 0.025 or 0.05 step is not affected.

cause: the editor builds its rate list with `Decimal(Double)`, so 0.59 becomes 0.5899999999999998976, and the picker writes `Decimal($0)` of a `Double` again. the editor then looks the rate up with `firstIndex(of:)`, an exact match. on a miss it falls back to index 0, the lowest rate. so after a reopen the row shows 0.01 and the total is wrong, and the next save sends 0.01 for every such row, also rows that were not edited. the value that was sent before was also 1 ulp low (0.5899999999999997), which the Dana-i stores as 0.58.

change:
- round the pump rates to 3 places, as `APSManager.supportedBasalRates` does.
- match a row to the largest pump rate that is not above it, so a rate is never rounded up.
- enable Save when a stored rate differs from its pump rate, so 1 save corrects a profile saved before this fix.
- round the `Double` sent to the pump to 3 places at the 4 places that sync the schedule.

not changed: the Dana-i still cuts some exact rates by 0.01 (for example 0.57 → 0.56) because DanaKit converts with `UInt16(rate * 100)`. that needs a DanaKit fix.

effect on other pumps (each driver's conversion run over its full rate list, old vs new value):
- Omnipod, Minimed x22/x23, Medtrum: same value on the pump for every rate.
- Dana-i: better for most rates (editor save: 26 better, 0 worse). from an exact source (Nightscout import, onboarding, Autotune) 9 rates are 0.01 lower, for example 0.57 → 0.56, because of the DanaKit truncation above.
- oref, Garmin, chart and bolus calculator: same. Nightscout upload, settings export and Tidepool: the exact rate (0.59, before 0.5899999999999999); Tidepool sends 1 extra settings upload.
- Tandem Mobi: not checked.

tested in the simulator with the pump simulator set to Dana increments (0.01 U/h):
- before: set 00:00 to 0.59 and save, reopen: the row shows 0.01 and the total 0.24 U/day. add a 00:30 row with 0.59 and save: 00:00 is saved and sent as 0.01.
- after: set 00:00 to 0.59 and save, reopen: the row shows 0.59 and the total 14.16 U/day; `basal_profile.json` and the pump schedule hold 0.59.

before:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6897b190-12c9-406b-a740-60b77460cdf1

after:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5fe61052-92fe-4bb8-9119-dfb0562dca57
